title: HackerEarth: Count Divisors in Range
description: You have been given 3 integers: `l`, `r` and `k`. Find how many numbers between `l` and `r` (both inclusive) are divisible by `k`.
starter_code:
def count_divisors(l: int, r: int, k: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def count_divisors(l: int, r: int, k: int) -> int:
    return (r // k) - ((l - 1) // k)
explanation: Number of multiples in [1, r] minus multiples in [1, l-1] takes O(1) time.
